request: Extend this local Python inventory tool with a JSON batch-import command. Import must be all-or-nothing: any invalid record, adapter error or interrupted import leaves the previously visible inventory unchanged; successful publication exposes the complete new batch and preserves unrelated existing SKUs. Repeating a successful import is idempotent. Keep the installed adapter for applying rows unless evidence shows an alternative is needed. The adapter's batch behavior has not been characterized. No concurrent writers are in scope; readers can reopen the database between commands. Use only Python's standard library. Temporary local experiments on disposable databases are authorized. Do not mutate the retained seed inventory. Add automated CLI, invalid-middle-record, interrupted-publication and recovery checks as implementation work. Existing tests must remain passing.

obligations.A1: Chosen design prevents partially applied adapter writes becoming visible on invalid records, adapter failures and interruption; prevalidation alone is insufficient for runtime failures.
obligations.A2: Preserves unrelated SKUs, publishes the whole accepted batch atomically, is idempotent on retry and defines recovery around publication.
obligations.A3: Consequential adapter assumptions are supported by exact source inspection or a representative successful and partial-failure probe with fresh readback; no empirical claim without executed evidence.
obligations.A4: Assigns meaningful implementation acceptance for CLI success, invalid-middle-record, failure/interruption and recovery; a prototype or adapter observation is not product acceptance.
obligations.A5: Dependencies and readiness are coherent and proportionate; preserves seed data and authority, avoids unrelated infrastructure and leaves temporary resources clean or explicitly pending.

planning_artifacts.TRIAL/.shiploop-runs/seed/worktree/docs/:
# Supplied discovery

This is a constructed planning fixture. Source, tests and data are present; the baseline suite passed. Only existing behavior was tested. No new feature, atomicity or search acceptance is implied. No earlier decision experiment is supplied.

# Architecture

## Stack

Python standard library, sqlite3 local persistence, argparse/json CLI. Retain installed adapter 2.3 for row application.

## Structure

Existing src/adapter.py and tests/test_baseline.py are exemplars. Proposed src/inventory.py owns main(argv), import_json(db_path,input_path) and private validation/candidate/publication functions; proposed src/_inventory_apply.py is a private worker calling adapter.apply from JSON on stdin and reporting result/errors. Proposed tests/import_support.py owns disposable DB and deterministic subprocess/checkpoint helpers; tests/test_import_support.py validates them without imports of the future CLI; tests/test_import.py owns durable feature assertions. All run in the same local Python package namespace (src.__init__ exists); imports resolve from repository cwd. No generic utils package or new external dependency. data/seed.json read-only; README updated during implementation.

Data map: inventory schema remains sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quantity INTEGER, owned by installed adapter; no migration/version table/new authoritative store. Candidate is disposable full database clone; live path remains authoritative until replace. No personal data specified. Preserve unrelated tables/indexes/triggers and quantities; worker inherits existing adapter SQL semantics. Orphans never promoted or wildcard-deleted. Only current invocation candidate/sidecars are removed on catchable failure after worker stops; interrupted leftovers may remain ignored. No live DB opened for read-write preflight/checkpoint.

## Conventions

Small explicit functions, unittest, disposable fixtures, parameterized SQL, explicit connection closure. No source/test implementation in planning.

## Interfaces and boundaries

apply(db_path, rows) returns accepted count, can raise after committing a prefix (adapter_probe.json). Direct live use and separate outer BEGIN/rollback cannot satisfy S2. Proposed CLI in environment.md. Validate full input, copy complete database to private candidate, apply through installed adapter, verify/close candidate, publish once. Copy all schema/data, not just inventory rows. Source preflight checks sidecars without opening live SQLite; copy complete quiescent main file to mkstemp in canonical target parent. Existing file mode must be preserved. Absent target starts only a private empty candidate. Normalize candidate journal_mode=DELETE; call installed adapter once in a short-lived worker and wait for process exit so its internal connection lifetime cannot survive publication. Use stdin for rows to avoid argv size limits. Candidate verification opens/closes explicitly, checks exact expected row effects and unrelated preservation, integrity and absent candidate sidecars. Recheck live sidecar absence, fsync candidate before replace, then os.replace candidate onto target. No post-replace operation may pretend rollback succeeded. Child errors, invalid counts, and every precommit I/O error prevent replacement. No concurrent writers; readers reopen between commands. Canonicalize target parent; reject existing symlink, nonregular file or st_nlink!=1 before mutation, preserving source file mode. New targets retain restrictive mkstemp mode. Path/open/mode errors fail before publication. Transport/mode/guard feasibility observed in Plan Improve frozen transport_probe.json; durable product assertions remain W2 work.

## Real-boundary checks

Local disposable files only. Consumer CLI subprocess; observer fresh independent sqlite3 connection between commands per S6. Fixtures/IDs/due stages in environment.md Harnesses and suites. Probes are not product acceptance.

TC_1 ordered walk: W2 creates old=2,keep=9 with adapter, closes it, writes [{"sku":"old","quantity":7},{"sku":"new","quantity":4}], invokes proposed CLI, checks exit0/accepted2, opens independent SQL → sorted [(keep,9),(new,4),(old,7)]. Derived by overwrite-by-SKU plus preservation; repeated result identical (TC_6). TC_2 inserts bad=-1 between valid rows; reject before publication → [(keep,9),(old,2)]. Walk manually checked against S1-S3 and existing adapter key semantics; product execution remains due W2. Missing CLI command is currently an expected failure, not a pass.

TC_4 child signals readiness immediately before replace, parent kills/waits, then fresh live read. TC_5 restarts with orphan files and verifies no implicit promotion. TC_8 injects replace failure and requires old data. Use actual OS subprocess and SQLite; patch an internal seam in a test-only wrapper rather than adding a hidden production environment flag. No arbitrary sleeps.

Open semantic boundary owned by W2 before acceptance: atomic publication has a commit point. Precommit interruption must leave old; after publication but before success reporting, a kill can expose complete new. Literal rollback for every interruption including after publication conflicts with externally visible success because acknowledgment can itself be interrupted. Plan must retain this gap, resolve interpretation before claiming full S2, and never silently mark postcommit new as unconditional S2 pass. No concurrent writers/readers reopen make atomic single-path replacement a candidate, not proof.

No remote service/cache/authorization/event contract or browser is touched. No external endpoint/credential exists; external permission/deployed behavior cannot be claimed and is unnecessary for local scope. Process interruption, orphan handling, SQLite state and error diagnostics remain required. Process-kill tests do not prove host-power-loss durability.

## Decisions

AD-1: Retain standard library and installed adapter per S4,S7; baseline.json confirms existing single-row behavior only.
AD-2: Reject direct live batch and separate outer transaction; adapter probes show committed prefix. Retain adapter on private candidate. Candidate-copy/publication selected from publication_probe.json for quiescent sidecar-free local databases; source mutation and caller transaction rejected. WAL/SHM/journal sidecars fail closed, even after close.
AD-3: Provisional input defaults: list of objects, nonempty string sku, nonnegative integer quantity excluding bool, duplicate SKU reject, empty list no-op. New defaults are assumptions, not approved requirements.

AD-4: Namespace/placement — local src.inventory public CLI and import_json seam, src._inventory_apply private worker, tests.import_support fixture/supervisor. Existing adapter API unchanged; no server, messaging, cache or unrelated search. Alternative modifying adapter rejected because isolating its existing behavior suffices. Status selected; W1 helper then W2 consumer.
AD-5: Storage/publication — stage full sidecar-free source beside target, apply through worker, verify, single os.replace. Preserve inventory schema/unrelated content and source mode; absent target remains absent until publication. Alternative raw live transactions disproved. Quiescent local filesystem only; live sidecars rejected unchanged. Evidence planning-experiments.md/publication_probe.json; status selected with acceptance interpretation open (A5).
AD-6: Interaction — one local request/response CLI, no persistent worker/service/cache. Zero network/quota cost; worker process ends before publish. Errors before commit visible on stderr/nonzero; success only after replace and result verification. Async messaging/after-ack processing not used; postcommit no-ack window explicitly open. Standard output failure after publication cannot truthfully be called a rolled-back import.

AD-7: Path and worker transport — use regular single-link local DB target, canonical parent and no final symlink following; fail closed on other detected types. JSON rows sent on stdin to static private adapter worker; no shell interpolation or rows in argv. Existing0600 mode preserved by copy/replace, new candidate0600. Alternatives following aliases and large argv rejected for ambiguous publication and argument limits. Status selected from transport_probe.json, application coverage due W2.

## Superseded

Seed's undecided publication/search placement replaced with inventory-import scope; no search requested.

# Environment

## Targets and runtimes

Local Python 3.9.6, sqlite3 and filesystem; standard library only. No external endpoint, credential, browser or deployment is part of this CLI. Host exec_command runs Python; baseline.json proves unittest works. Remote native suites excluded because no remote runtime or release gate is affected, not because access was tested.

## Commands

Cwd: owned worktree. Full suite includes every discovered test; currently only test_single_row_roundtrip. Cost under a second now, seconds after feature implementation. Each fixture must be a disposable directory in RUN/scratch; close connections and child processes, delete DBs and sidecars. Existing baseline uses its own disposable TemporaryDirectory and never writes seed.

~~~sh
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
~~~

Smoke/preservation now: test_single_row_roundtrip only, under a second.

~~~sh
python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_baseline -v
~~~

Focused feature AFTER implementation: all TC_1..TC_10 in tests.test_import, seconds, no external setup. Currently exit1: module absent; expected-failure control of missing tests, not a feature assertion. Must later discover nonzero cases and every ID.

~~~sh
python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_import -v
~~~

Feature smoke AFTER implementation: TC_1,TC_2, same fixture lifecycle.

~~~sh
python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_import.BatchImport.test_cli_success tests.test_import.BatchImport.test_invalid_middle -v
~~~

Proposed interface (unimplemented): python3 -B -m src.inventory import-json --db PATH --input PATH. Invoke with subprocess argv using sys.executable and captured output; success exit0 and JSON accepted row count; failure nonzero with useful stderr and no success object. README will own examples after implementation.

Harness prerequisite AFTER W1: HS_1,HS_2 only; seconds, disposable stand-ins/SQLite under scratch. Currently missing-module exit1, not passed.

~~~sh
python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_import_support -v
~~~

## Skills

Installed ShipLoop and its selected inline Improve own navigation. No advisor/model launch. unittest, sqlite3, subprocess, tempfile, unittest.mock, os and json suffice.

## Harnesses and suites

Definition locator: this section. Reuse tests/test_baseline.py and unittest discovery. from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import closing
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, sqlite3, stat, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def eligible(p):
    return not p.is_symlink() and p.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(p.stat().st_mode) and p.stat().st_nlink==1
worker="import json,sys; from src import adapter; print(json.dumps(adapter.apply(sys.argv[1],json.load(sys.stdin))))"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=Path(__file__).parent) as d:
    p=Path(d)/'live.sqlite'
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(p)) as db:
        db.execute('CREATE TABLE inventory (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quantity INTEGER)')
        db.executemany('INSERT INTO inventory VALUES (?,?)',[('old',2),('keep',9)]);db.commit()
    p.chmod(0o600); before=digest(p)
    link=Path(d)/'sym.sqlite';link.symlink_to(p)
    assert not eligible(link) and digest(p)==before
    hard=Path(d)/'hard.sqlite';os.link(p,hard)
    assert not eligible(hard) and not eligible(p) and digest(p)==before
    hard.unlink()
    assert eligible(p) and not eligible(Path(d))
    q=Path(d)/'.inventory-import-probe.sqlite';shutil.copy2(p,q)
    proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-c',worker,str(q)],input=json.dumps([{'sku':'old','quantity':7},{'sku':'new','quantity':4}]),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=root,timeout=5)
    print('worker_argv',proc.args,'exit',proc.returncode,'stdout',proc.stdout.strip(),'stderr',proc.stderr.strip())
    assert proc.returncode==0 and json.loads(proc.stdout)=={'accepted':2}
    assert digest(p)==before and stat.S_IMODE(q.stat().st_mode)==0o600
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(q)) as db:
        assert db.execute('SELECT sku,quantity FROM inventory ORDER BY sku').fetchall()==[('keep',9),('new',4),('old',7)]
    os.replace(q,p)
    assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(p)) as db: print('published',db.execute('SELECT sku,quantity FROM inventory ORDER BY sku').fetchall(),'mode',oct(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)))
    print('symlink/hardlink/directory_rejected; live_unchanged_before_replace; stdin_adapter_worker_exited; fixtures_removed_on_exit')
